My role

I explored procedural walking in my free time and wrote movement logic for a humanoid character.

Technical approach

The implementation combined ground detection using raycasts with interpolated foot positions and step height. It was an opportunity to understand how individual calculations produce visible motion.

Result

The experiment produced a procedural walking demonstration and gave me practice reasoning about movement over time.
